title: Device comparison report
summary: {records} similar reports; {groups} read/write tests can be compared statistically
record_count_notice: Counts refer to public reports, not independent devices or users.
comparable: Required recorded conditions match. Unmeasured conditions can still differ.
background: Background only: conditions differ or are missing. These values are excluded from statistics.
threshold: Statistics require at least three comparable records for that measurement. With fewer records, only individual examples are shown; missing values are not zero.
no_sources: No reference records are available for this test.
author: Report attribution
no_interpretation: This report contains comparison facts. Additional interpretation has not been provided.
formula: Difference = (this measurement / reference median − 1) × 100%. A positive latency difference means slower responses. No percentage is calculated for a zero median.
confounders: Temperature, firmware, background load and previous writes are not controlled. Matching models do not establish comparable conditions.
historical: This is a historical snapshot. Current eligibility may change; saved files cannot be recalled. Opening this report does not refresh references or make a network request.
authenticity: A single performance difference cannot establish a quality defect or counterfeit device. These records do not replace capacity or read-back verification.
unknown_recovery_idle: Recovery idle time was not recorded
value_quiet_observed: No activity observed in two pre-run windows; not a whole-run guarantee
value_interference_observed: Attributed activity observed before the run
value_visibility_limited: Pre-run activity attribution or visibility limited
